title: Theme: Weak rupee + China+1 export winners (research date 2026-11-19)

body: Rating rationales are an under-read, free, third-party diligence document. Analysts meet management, and the rationale lists key drivers, liquidity, covenants, related-party exposure and 'what could trigger downgrade'. Tested 2026-11-19: ICRA works. The rationale page is an HTML shell; the PDF sits at icra.in/Rating/ShowRationalReportFilePdfViewer/<Id> (9-page PDF downloaded). CRISIL works: plain HTML at crisil.com/mnt/winshare/Ratings/RatingList/RatingDocs/<Company>_<Month DD_ YYYY>_RR_<id>.html (Tega Industries Mar-2026 fetched, about 27K chars including Key Rating Drivers). CARE pages load but are JS-heavy, with no simple endpoint found. India Ratings is a JS single-page app, so curl gets only a shell. The practical route for all four is that companies must disclose rating actions as Reg 30 exchange filings ('Credit Rating' announcements), and screener.in lists rating links on company pages. Red flags to track: 'Issuer Not Cooperating' (borrower stopped sharing information, a strong governance warning), Watch Negative, and liquidity downgraded to 'Stretched'.
title: Credit rating rationales (ICRA, CRISIL, CARE, India Ratings) - access
